 4             MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE LATE-FILED DIRECT TESTIMONY

 5             BEFORE THE STATE OFFICE OF ADMINISTRATIVE HEARINGS

 6   COMES NOW Brandon Fortie (“Movant”), appearing pro se, and respectfully requests

 7   leave to file late-filed Direct Testimony in the above-captioned proceeding.


 8      1. Movant filed a Motion to Intervene because the proposed transmission line

 9         directly affects his occupied residence and property located within Segment A2.

10      2. Movant is a pro se landowner and is not represented by counsel.

11      3. Movant was not approved as an intervenor until after the May 13, 2026 testimony

12         deadline had passed and did not personally receive notice from Oncor regarding

13         the testimony deadline prior to intervention approval.



                                                                                 Motion for Leave to File
                                                        Late - Filed Direct Testimony of Brandon Fortie
                                                                                 PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                       SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                             Page 1 of 3
  1   4. The A2 Segment Affected Landowners Coalition has been informally assisting

 2      neighboring landowners with organizing and filing testimony. The coalition

 3      coordinator assisting Movant is not an attorney and was attempting in good faith

 4      to help her neighbors navigate the filing process.

 5   5. Movant did not provide his testimony materials to the coalition coordinator until

 6      after approximately 11:00 p.m. on May 13, 2026. At that time, the coordinator

 7      believed the filing deadline had already passed and that the testimony could no

 8      longer be submitted. The coordinator has since learned that leave may be

 9      requested for late-filed testimony and is therefore submitting this request.

10   6. An additional reason for the late filing is that Movant is currently serving on active

11      reserve duty orders, which has limited his availability and ability to timely prepare

12      and coordinate his testimony materials.

13   7. The attached testimony is limited to Movant’s own property, residence, and

14      personal observations regarding Route A2, including the proposed transmission

15      line being located approximately 282 feet from his occupied home on Parcel

16      3520.

17   8. Allowing the testimony will not unfairly prejudice the parties because the

18      testimony concerns route-specific residential and land use impacts already at

19      issue in this proceeding and does not introduce new claims or theories.




                                                                              Motion for Leave to File
                                                     Late - Filed Direct Testimony of Brandon Fortie
                                                                              PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                    SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                          Page 2 of 3
  1      9. Excluding the testimony would substantially prejudice Movant’s ability to

 2          participate in a proceeding that directly affects his home, property, and rural

 3          residential land use.


 4   WHEREFORE, PREMISES CONSIDERED, Movant respectfully requests that the

 5   Administrative Law Judges grant leave to file the attached late-filed Direct Testimony

 6   and for such other and further relief to which he may be justly entitled.


 7
